A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VADTree research work. Their complete 33-page texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original VADTree evaluations on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, including ablations, computational measurements, and repeated-run results.

after.justification: The same original benchmark evaluations, ablations, computational measurements, and repeated-run results remain in Section 4 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: HGTree construction, prior-infused scoring, intra-cluster refinement, and inter-cluster fusion are unchanged. Both versions already name LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2 in the implementation paragraph; the revised appendix link does not establish an actual backbone or algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, the same visual and audiovisual evaluations, and the same supplementary test scenarios. No dataset, task, or represented population is added or removed.

E2.justification: The benchmark baselines, alternative VLM/LLM combinations, GEBD models, and sampling comparators are unchanged. SceneDetect's superscript changes from 4 to 5 solely through footnote renumbering.

E3.justification: Section 4.2 revises the reported LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B input resolution from 336 × 336 to 384 × 384, retaining 64 frames. This is a limited reported setting change; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun. Other evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix C retain the same component ablations, GEBD comparisons, sensitivity analyses for K, temperature and fusion weights, sampling analyses, and qualitative case studies. No analytical question or supporting evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix C.8 and Table 17 retain the same three runs, mean results, and delta column. The checklist's statement about reporting means and standard deviations is also unchanged; no statistical reporting practice is added.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. Tables 1–3 retain VADTree AUC values of 84.74% on UCF-Crime, 90.44% on XD-Violence, and 89.32% on MSAD. The revised input specification is not accompanied by revised result entries.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations, TreeInit algorithm in Appendix A.1, and coverage-completeness theorem and proof in Appendix A.2 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free hierarchical event modeling, explainability, sampling efficiency, and competitive or state-of-the-art detection performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning semantic noise, hierarchical fusion, boundary quality, and generalization are unchanged. Appendix D retains the same dependence on VLM perception and difficulty detecting small visual cues; Appendix E retains the same privacy discussion.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 changes the VLM repository link from LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B to LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2, matching the model already named in both implementation sections. Section 4.2 also revises the documented input resolution. Prompts, hardware, other hyperparameters, and code-availability statements are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to training-free VAD and event-based video understanding remain unchanged. The model repository correction changes implementation access information, not the related-work discussion.

P1.justification: v3 identifies Yifei Xu as corresponding author, updates the version/date header, and renumbers footnotes. Apart from the specific technical edits, the prose, terminology, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added corresponding-author footnote causes limited text reflow across pages 1–4, with subsequent footnote numbering adjustments. Figures and tables retain their content, structure, captions, and placement; there is no substantive visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The revised Appendix B.1 model link improves reproducibility by matching the LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2 model already specified in the implementation section. The benefit is limited: Section 4.2 and Tables 6 and 15 still use LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B naming, leaving some ambiguity. The resolution specification changes, but the empirical evidence, theory, and conclusions are unchanged.
